Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8096); Semei (i.e. Shimi), an Israelite:--Semei.
BiblicalUsage: Semei stands in the genealogy of Jesus, the son of Mattathias, in the line from Joseph back to Juda. The Greek text behind the King James Version spells his name with a circumflex on the final vowel, while the text I have checked spells it with the full ending.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy keeps even the quietest links, and Semei is there because the chain has no missing piece.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
